title: World Pulse
pitch: Wire God's Eye View's live global data feed (flight density, seismic activity, ship traffic, wildfire spread) into YuE2's agentic music generator so the mood, tempo, and instrumentation of a generated soundtrack shift in real time with what's actually happening on Earth right now — calm ambient pads on a quiet night, tense strings when a storm cluster forms over the Atlantic. Sell it as a live 'ambient news score' for Twitch streamers doing 24/7 world-events streams, gallery/art installations, and newsroom livestream backgrounds, priced as a monthly API subscription per channel.
why_now: Both projects trended the same day: one gives a rich, constantly-updating stream of real-world signals, the other gives agentic, controllable music generation good enough to score with. Livestreaming and ambient 'world dashboard' content is already popular; nobody has wired a generative soundtrack directly to live planetary data yet.
